name: Household chores
description: The jobs that keep a home running, who's on each this week, and when each was last done.

chore.description: A job that comes round again, like the dishes or the bins.

assigned.description: who is on this chore this week

in-area.description: the part of the home it belongs to

person.description: Someone who lives here and shares the work.

area.description: A part of the home, like the kitchen or the garden.

add-chore.title: Add a chore
add-chore.description: Add a job that comes round again, and how often.

add-chore-here.title: Add a chore in this area
add-chore-here.description: Add a chore that belongs to this part of the home, by name, and how often it comes round.

give-chore.title: Add a chore for them
give-chore.description: Add a new chore and put this person on it.

done-today.title: Done it today
done-today.description: Record that a chore was done today.

set-often.title: Change how often
set-often.description: Say how often a chore comes round: daily, weekly, fortnightly or monthly.

assign.title: Give to someone
assign.description: Put someone on a chore this week, in place of whoever had it.
assign.fromTheOtherEnd: Give them one of our chores

unassign.title: Take off them
unassign.description: Take a person off a chore.

move-chore.title: Move to an area
move-chore.description: Say which part of the home a chore belongs to.
move-chore.fromTheOtherEnd: Move one of our chores here

add-person.title: Add a person
add-person.description: Add someone who lives here and shares the work.

add-area.title: Add an area
add-area.description: Add a part of the home to group chores by.

take-out-of-area.title: Take out of its area
take-out-of-area.description: Say a chore no longer belongs to the area it was in.
take-out-of-area.fromTheOtherEnd: Take one of our chores out of here

chore-has-someone.title: Every chore has somebody on it
chore-has-someone.description: A chore that is everyone's job is nobody's.

chore-not-overdue.title: Chores are done as often as they come round

grants.describe: Owners and editors may do everything; viewers can look.
